summary: Morgan Stanley filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly common stock dividend increase to $1.15 per share from $1.00, a 15% rise. The dividend applies to the common stock and will commence with the declaration expected in the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The board authorized the increase, reflecting strong capital position. Terms include per-share amount only; no premium, advisors, or structural conditions. This is a routine capital return action not linked to any other event. Watch for sustained earnings coverage and payout ratio evolution.
